description.en: The USB Standard-A (Series A) plug interface: a shell 12.00 × 4.50 mm, at least 11.75 mm long ahead of the overmold, mating a Standard-A receptacle one way up.
description.es: La interfaz de la clavija USB Estándar A (Serie A): una carcasa de 12.00 × 4.50 mm, de al menos 11.75 mm de largo delante del sobremoldeo, que acopla con un receptáculo Estándar A en una sola posición.
description.fr: L'interface de la fiche USB Standard-A (série A) : un blindage de 12,00 × 4,50 mm, long d'au moins 11,75 mm devant le surmoulage, qui s'accouple à une embase Standard-A dans un seul sens.
description.pt: A interface da ficha USB Standard-A (Série A): uma blindagem de 12,00 × 4,50 mm, com pelo menos 11,75 mm de comprimento à frente do sobremoldado, que acopla num receptáculo Standard-A num só sentido.

sources.title: Universal Serial Bus Specification, Revision 2.0 (April 27, 2000), chapter 6
sources.supports: Figure 6-7 (Series A receptacle interface): opening 12.50 ±0.10 wide, 5.12 ±0.10 high; tongue 11.10 ±0.10 wide, 8.38 ±0.08 long; 8.88 ±0.20 from the tongue root to the front face; contacts at ±1.00 and ±3.50 from the centre line, 1.00 ±0.05 wide; mated, 2.67 min from the receptacle face to the plug's overmold. Figure 6-9 (Series A plug): shell 12.00 ±0.10 wide, 4.50 ±0.10 high; 11.75 min from the tip to the overmold; cavity 8.65 ±0.19 deep; overmold 16.0 max wide, 8.0 max high. Table 6-1: four contacts and the shell

sources.title: USB 3.1 Legacy Cable and Connector Specification, Revision 1.0 (September 22, 2017)
sources.supports: Figure 5-1 detail Y: the Standard-A receptacle opening 12.50 ±0.10 × 5.12 ±0.10 and the 11.10 ±0.10 tongue width, labelled; Figure 5-4: the Standard-A plug shell 12.00 ±0.10 × 4.50 ±0.10

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the overmold's front face, on the shell axis. +z runs along the shell to its tip at z = 11.75; +x runs along the shell's width; +y = z × x runs along its height, pointing toward the half of the shell that holds the contact insulator. The overmold and cable lie at z < 0.

shell_width.note: the USB 3.1 legacy specification's Figure 5-4 agrees (source 1)

shell_length_min.note: from the tip to the overmold

interfaces.note: Male: the shell goes into a Standard-A receptacle, one way up. A mate seats the overmold face on the receptacle's front face, a convention: the specification keeps them at least 2.67 apart when mated. The x_axis is −x so that a mate (a half-turn about the frame's x, ASM-1 §3.4) puts the plug's +y side on the receptacle's +y side.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The overmold's length is not normative, so only the shell, at its minimum cited length, is in the envelope.

solids.note: the shell, overmold face to tip, at its minimum length

envelope.note: The shell at its nominal width and height and minimum length; the overmold is not modelled.
